activities.name: hpc-produce
activities.run:
set -eu
printf 'origin=hpc\n' > journey.txt
sha256sum journey.txt > journey.sha256

activities.name: cloud-transform
activities.run:
set -eu
sha256sum -c journey.sha256
printf 'processed=cloud\n' >> journey.txt
sha256sum journey.txt > journey.sha256

activities.name: local-validate
activities.run:
set -eu
sha256sum -c journey.sha256
grep -qx 'origin=hpc' journey.txt
grep -qx 'processed=cloud' journey.txt
printf 'validated=local\n' >> journey.txt
sha256sum journey.txt > journey.sha256

activities.name: hpc-finalize
activities.run:
set -eu
sha256sum -c journey.sha256
grep -qx 'origin=hpc' journey.txt
grep -qx 'processed=cloud' journey.txt
grep -qx 'validated=local' journey.txt
printf 'finalized=hpc\n' >> journey.txt
sha256sum journey.txt > journey.sha256
printf 'roundtrip=verified\n' > final.receipt
test -s final.receipt
